q: The Douady-Hubbard theorem on the connectedness of the Julia set for a polynomial states that J(f) is connected iff:
opts: The critical points have bounded orbits
exp: For a polynomial, J(f) is connected iff all critical points have bounded orbits (equivalently, all critical points are in the filled Julia set K(f)). If any critical point escapes to ∞, J(f) is a Cantor set (totally disconnected). For z²+c this gives c ∈ Mandelbrot set ↔ J(f) connected.
